theme.title: Theme
theme.systemDesc: Follows Windows light or dark mode
theme.systemDescNeutral: Follows the system light or dark mode

density.label: Density
density.desc: Compact tightens margins and rows to show more posters at once.

zoom.label: Interface Scale
zoom.desc: Makes all of Wicaby larger or smaller, text included.

cardTitles.label: Titles Under Posters
cardTitles.desc: When off, only the artwork shows. Wide thumbnails keep their titles.

cardRatings.label: Audience Rating
cardRatings.desc: Shows the rating on the artwork, for example ★ 7.4.

cardAges.label: Age Rating
cardAges.desc: Shows the server’s rating, for example PG-13 or TV-MA.

cardQuality.label: Video Quality
cardQuality.desc: Shows 4K, HD, or SD on movies and episodes.

hero.label: Featured Banner
hero.desc: The large artwork at the top of Home, with what you’re watching or what’s new.

heroAutoplay.label: Auto-Advance
heroAutoplay.desc: Moves to the next banner every 8 seconds.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce Motion
reduceMotion.desc: Removes zooms and transitions. Also follows the Windows setting.
reduceMotion.descLinux: Removes zooms and transitions. Also follows the system setting.

reduceTransparency.label: Reduce Transparency
reduceTransparency.desc: Makes bars and menus opaque. Helps on less powerful GPUs.

player.label: Player
player.desc: Auto uses mpv when it’s available, and the built-in player otherwise.
player.title: Player

bitrateLocal.label: Maximum Bitrate (Local)
bitrateLocal.desc: When the server is reached at a private address (home, office). Above this, it transcodes.

bitrateRemote.label: Maximum Bitrate (Remote)
bitrateRemote.desc: Over the internet or a VPN. Lower it if playback stalls when you’re away from home.

maxResolution.label: Maximum Resolution
maxResolution.desc: Above this, the server scales the picture down. Useful on a slow connection or a small screen.

forceTranscode.label: Always Transcode
forceTranscode.desc: The server always re-encodes the video, even when mpv could play the file as is.

playback.connection: {kind, select, lan {Current connection: local network ({address}).} other {Current connection: remote ({address}).}}

resume.label: Resume
resume.desc: For the play buttons on posters and episodes. The details page keeps both buttons.

speed.label: Default Speed
speed.desc: For movies and episodes. You can change it during playback.

seekShort.label: Short Skip
seekShort.desc: Left and right arrows, and the playback bar buttons.

seekLong.label: Long Skip
seekLong.desc: Shift with the left and right arrows.

playback.remoteControlHint: Wicaby appears under “Play On” in Emby and Jellyfin apps.

inWindowVideo.label: Video inside Wicaby's window
inWindowVideo.desc: On Wayland, video plays under Wicaby's own controls. Turn it off if the picture stays black: mpv then opens its own window. Applies at the next start.

pauseOnMinimize.label: Pause When Minimized
pauseOnMinimize.desc: Playback pauses when you minimize the video window.

autoPlayNext.label: Autoplay Next Episode
autoPlayNext.desc: Starts the next episode automatically when one ends.

countdown.label: Countdown
countdown.desc: How long the Up Next card shows before the next episode.

skipIntro.label: Skip Intro
skipIntro.desc: On Emby, your server account’s setting applies if it’s set.

skipCredits.label: Skip Credits
skipCredits.desc: Auto moves to the next episode (or ends) as soon as the end credits start.

skipRecap.label: Skip Recaps
skipRecap.desc: The “Previously on” at the start of an episode, when the server marks it (Jellyfin media segments).

skipPreview.label: Skip Previews
skipPreview.desc: The next-episode teaser, often after the credits.

aniskip.label: AniSkip for Anime
aniskip.desc: Fills in missing anime intro and credits times from aniskip.com (sends the MyAnimeList id and episode number).

communitySegments.label: Community Timestamps
communitySegments.desc: Intro, recap, credits and preview from TheIntroDB and IntroDB. Sends the watched title's id to these services.

mpv.title: mpv Engine
mpv.missing: Choose an existing mpv.exe, or get a build with {command}.
mpv.missingLinux: Install mpv 0.37 or later with your distribution’s package manager, or choose its file.

mpvConf.label: Use mpv.conf
mpvConf.desc: Loads your mpv configuration (scalers, profiles, font) after Wicaby’s.

hwdec.label: Hardware Decoding
hwdec.desc: D3D11VA works with all recent GPUs, NVDEC with NVIDIA cards. For video; interface acceleration is in System.
hwdec.descLinux: VA-API works with Intel and AMD GPUs, NVDEC with NVIDIA cards, Vulkan with recent drivers. For video; interface acceleration is in System.

hdrPassthrough.label: HDR Passthrough
hdrPassthrough.desc: On an HDR display, passes the source’s HDR metadata through. When off, mpv tone-maps the picture to the display’s peak brightness.

hdrAuto.label: Turn On Windows HDR Automatically
hdrAuto.desc: Turns on Windows HDR when an HDR or Dolby Vision title starts in mpv, and restores it when playback stops.

smooth.label: Smooth Playback
smooth.desc: Times frames to the display’s refresh rate.
smooth.why: Without it, the sound card’s and the display’s clocks drift slightly apart, so mpv now and then drops a frame to stay in sync with the sound, a small stutter. With it, frames follow the display and the sound is adjusted inaudibly. Always off for audio sent untouched to an amplifier.

matchRefresh.label: Match Frame Rate
matchRefresh.desc: Switches the display to 24, 25, 50, or 60 Hz to match the video and remove judder.
matchRefresh.unavailable: Needs an X11 session with xrandr, or KDE Plasma on Wayland with kscreen-doctor.

aspect.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect.desc: The format every video starts in. A change made during playback is kept as set in Remember Settings.

cinemaMode.label: Trailers Before Movies
cinemaMode.desc: Plays one or two trailers stored on the server before a movie, except when resuming.

output.label: Audio Output
output.desc: Used by mpv. The built-in player follows Windows.
output.descLinux: Used by mpv. The built-in player follows the system output.
output.needsMpv: mpv is required to choose an output.
output.title: Output

audioDescription.label: Audio Description
audioDescription.desc: Narrated tracks for the blind and visually impaired. Avoid never picks one automatically when a plain track exists in the same language.

language.label: Preferred Language
language.desc: The track chosen by default when it exists.
language.title: Language

exclusive.label: Exclusive Mode (WASAPI)
exclusive.desc: mpv takes exclusive control of the output, without Windows mixing.
exclusive.descLinux: mpv takes exclusive control of the output, without PipeWire or PulseAudio mixing.

normalize.label: Normalize Volume
normalize.desc: Evens out loudness between scenes and from one title to the next, without changing your volume settings.

boost.label: Volume Boost up to 150%
boost.desc: For movies mixed too quietly. Above 100%, peaks may clip.

night.label: Reduce Loud Sounds
night.desc: Narrows the gap between dialogue and explosions for listening at low volume.

dialogue.label: Enhance Dialogue
dialogue.desc: Brings out the center channel in 5.1 and 7.1, and speech in stereo.

audio.volumeFoot: Normalize Volume, Reduce Loud Sounds, and Enhance Dialogue apply with mpv, even during playback.
audio.passthroughFoot: Enabled formats are sent as is to your receiver over HDMI or S/PDIF, which decodes them. Passthrough forces WASAPI exclusive mode, whatever the setting above. Volume, Reduce Loud Sounds, and Enhance Dialogue don’t apply to these tracks. Takes effect the next time mpv starts.
audio.passthroughFootLinux: Enabled formats are sent as is to your receiver over HDMI or S/PDIF, which decodes them. The output must accept passthrough (enable it in PipeWire or PulseAudio, or turn on Exclusive Mode); otherwise Wicaby falls back to PCM. Volume, Reduce Loud Sounds, and Enhance Dialogue don’t apply to these tracks. Takes effect the next time mpv starts.

music.replayGainDesc: Evens out the volume from one track to the next with the files’ gains, else the server’s.
music.gaplessHint: Plays tracks back to back with no silence (mpv player).
music.fallbackNote: The built-in player supports neither gapless playback nor ReplayGain tags.
music.lyricsOnlineHint: Sends the artist, title and album to lrclib.net when the server has no lyrics.
music.sourceHint: The server whose libraries and playlists the Music section shows. Automatic: every server. Navidrome keeps your favourites (stars) and playlists.

language.label: Preferred Language
language.desc: The track chosen by default when it exists.

manual.label: Manual
manual.desc: Only forced subtitles. Others when you turn them on.

foreign.label: Foreign Audio Only
foreign.desc: When the audio isn’t in your language. Otherwise, only forced subtitles.

always.label: Always
always.desc: Always in your language when the track exists.

default.label: As in File
default.desc: Follows the default track of the file and the server.

preferSdh.label: Prefer SDH Subtitles
preferSdh.desc: Subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing (sounds, speakers) when the language has them.

alwaysForced.label: Always Show Forced Subtitles
alwaysForced.desc: Foreign-language passages and signs stay translated, even with subtitles off.

subtitles.forcedFoot: Forced subtitles translate only foreign passages and signs. A choice made during an episode is kept for the whole series.
subtitles.sample: This is how your subtitles look.

scaleWithVideo.label: Scale with Video
scaleWithVideo.desc: Subtitles follow the picture height rather than the window’s, so they’re smaller on a Scope movie.

overrideAss.label: Apply to ASS Subtitles
overrideAss.desc: Also replaces the style of styled (animated) subtitles. When off, their layout and embedded fonts are kept.

subtitles.footMpvConf: mpv.conf is on, so your mpv configuration decides the style.
subtitles.footStyle: The style applies with mpv, even during playback. Image subtitles (PGS, VobSub) keep their own.

customizeHome.label: Customize Home
customizeHome.desc: Choose and reorder rows: Continue Watching, Up Next, Recently Added, Favorites…

sort.label: Default Sort
sort.desc: For libraries whose sort you haven’t changed yet.

view.label: View
view.desc: Tall posters or wide thumbnails for movies and TV shows.

library.foot: A sort chosen in a library’s toolbar applies only to that library.
library.sidebarFoot: An empty group stays hidden even when on.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.label: MDBList API key
ratings.desc: Shows IMDb, Rotten Tomatoes, Metacritic, Letterboxd and TMDb ratings on movie and series pages. Off until a key is set; then each page sends the title’s IMDb or TMDb ID to mdblist.com.
ratings.hint: Free: sign in at mdblist.com, then Preferences → API Key.

concurrent.label: Simultaneous Downloads
concurrent.desc: Interrupted downloads pick up where they left off.

add.label: Add Server
add.desc: Emby or Jellyfin. Its libraries appear alongside those of your other servers.

switch.label: Switch Server
switch.desc: Sign-in details for your other servers stay saved.

server.foot: Your access token is encrypted by Windows and never leaves this device.
server.footLinux: Your access token is encrypted by the system keyring and never leaves this device.

quickConnect.label: Authorize a Device
quickConnect.desc: Enter the Quick Connect code another device shows to sign it in as you.

closeToTray.label: Close to Notification Area
closeToTray.desc: Closing the window hides it without quitting, so playback continues. To quit, right-click the Wicaby icon.
closeToTray.descLinux: Closing the window hides it without quitting, so playback continues. To quit, right-click the Wicaby icon. Needs a desktop that shows tray icons.

launchAtStartup.label: Launch When Windows Starts
launchAtStartup.desc: Wicaby starts in the notification area, without opening a window.
launchAtStartup.descLinux: Wicaby starts in the system tray, without opening a window.

notifyDownloads.label: Completed Downloads
notifyDownloads.desc: Lets you know when something is available offline.

notifyNewEpisodes.label: New Episodes
notifyNewEpisodes.desc: For shows you’re following: one you’re watching or one that’s up next.

notifyAdmin.label: Admin Alerts
notifyAdmin.desc: On servers you manage: a failed scheduled task, a restart required, or an update available.

windows.foot: Click a notification to open what it’s about.

imageCache.label: Image Cache
imageCache.desc: Posters and artwork already downloaded. They’ll be fetched from the server again.
imageCache.descSize: Posters and artwork already downloaded · {size}. They’ll be fetched from the server again.

apiCache.label: API Cache
apiCache.desc: Server responses kept for two minutes, so going back is instant.

comicCache.label: Comics Cache
comicCache.desc: Archives opened in the reader. The oldest are removed past the limit.
comicCache.descSize: Archives opened in the reader · {size}. The oldest are removed past the limit.

logs.label: Logs
logs.desc: Diagnostic logs. Today’s log is kept.
logs.descSize: Diagnostic logs · {size}. Today’s log is kept.

dataFolder.label: Data Folder
dataFolder.desc: Wicaby’s settings, saved servers, and caches.

plainTextVault.label: Keep Sign-ins Without a Keyring
plainTextVault.desc: No system keyring (GNOME Keyring, KWallet) is available, so your access tokens can’t be encrypted. Off, they stay in memory and you sign in again at each launch. On, they’re saved to disk without real encryption, readable by anyone with access to your files.

privacy.vaultMemory: No system keyring is available, so these credentials aren’t encrypted. They stay in memory only and are forgotten when Wicaby closes.
privacy.vaultDisk: No system keyring is available, so these credentials aren’t encrypted. They’re saved to disk without real encryption, as chosen in System.
privacy.foot: Clearing caches doesn’t delete your downloads or sign-in details.

hwAccel.label: Interface Hardware Acceleration
hwAccel.desc: For the interface; video decoding is in Video. When off, the interface is drawn without the GPU. Try it if you see a black screen or flickering.

fps.label: Frame Rate Counter
fps.desc: Shows how smooth the interface is in a corner of the window.

mpvArgs.label: Additional Arguments
mpvArgs.desc: mpv options separated by spaces, applied the next time mpv starts. Example: {example}
mpvArgs.rejected: Ignored: {args}. Write each option as --name=value (or --no-name). Only picture, scaling, shader, subtitle, sync, deband, dither, interpolation, tone-mapping, and audio options are allowed; scripts, config files, and logs are refused. File paths (subtitles, shaders) must be full paths on a local drive (C:\…) or in mpv’s folder (~~/…), never on a network share.

exportImport.label: Export or Import
exportImport.desc: A JSON file with all your settings, for another PC or a reinstall.

reset.label: Reset All Settings
reset.desc: Restores the original values. Servers, accounts, and downloads are kept.

cast.discovery: Look for TVs and Chromecasts on the local network
cast.relayHint: The TV never receives your access token. This computer must stay on during playback.
cast.allowHevcHint: For TVs with Chromecast built in that decode HEVC.
cast.dolby: The TV or amplifier accepts Dolby (AC3/EAC3)

about.trademarks: DLNA and UPnP are trademarks of their respective owners; Wicaby is not certified.

updates.title: Updates
updates.autoDesc: Once a day, on GitHub. Nothing is downloaded without you.

path.mesh: The connection through NetBird/Tailscale failed. The routing peer can’t reach this address.
path.outside: The direct connection failed, and this address is in no NetBird/Tailscale route (neither a peer nor in a routed network).
path.off: The direct connection failed, and Remote Access (NetBird/Tailscale) isn’t connected.
path.failed: The direct connection failed, and NetBird/Tailscale couldn’t open a route to this address.

torrents.hint: Turn on the Web UI in qBittorrent (Options, Web UI), then enter its address.

cert.title: Unrecognized Certificate
cert.body: {host} presents a certificate that Windows doesn’t recognize, often a self-signed one. Accept it only if this is really your qBittorrent.
cert.bodyLinux: {host} presents a certificate that your system doesn’t recognize, often a self-signed one. Accept it only if this is really your qBittorrent.

torrents.passwordNote: The password is encrypted by Windows on this device.
torrents.passwordNoteLinux: The password is encrypted by the system keyring on this device.
torrents.needQbt: Connect qBittorrent to link its categories to your libraries.
torrents.needServer: Sign in to your server to link categories to its libraries.
torrents.noCategories: qBittorrent has no categories. Create one per media type, for example “movies” and “shows”.

scan.label: Scan Library When Done
scan.desc: When a torrent in a linked category finishes, Wicaby asks the server to scan the library. Requires an administrator account.

notify.label: Notify When a Torrent Finishes
notify.desc: A Windows notification announces each finished torrent.
notify.descLinux: A desktop notification announces each finished torrent.

magnet.label: Open Magnet Links with Wicaby
magnet.desc: Magnet links opened in your browser go to Wicaby. Each link is confirmed before it’s added.

scrobble.title: Scrobbling
scrobble.lbHint: Off by default. Paste your user token from listenbrainz.org/settings to send the music you play in Wicaby to ListenBrainz.
scrobble.fmHint: Off by default. Last.fm needs your own API account: open Advanced to enter its key and secret.
scrobble.fmKeyHint: Create an API account at last.fm/api/account/create (any name, no callback URL), then paste its API key and shared secret here.
scrobble.fmWaitingDesc: Sign in on the Last.fm page that opened and choose Yes, allow access. Wicaby is waiting.
scrobble.connectedDesc: Tracks you play in Wicaby are scrobbled once you’ve heard half of them or 4 minutes.
scrobble.serverNote: If your server already scrobbles (a Last.fm or ListenBrainz plugin, or Navidrome), leave this off to avoid duplicates.
scrobble.foot: Tokens and secrets are encrypted by Windows on this device and are never logged.
scrobble.footLinux: Tokens and secrets are encrypted by the system keyring on this device and are never logged.

trakt.hint: Trakt requires an app in your name: create one at trakt.tv/oauth/applications with the redirect URI urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob, then paste its Client ID and Client Secret here.
trakt.codeDesc: Open {url}, sign in, and enter the code. Wicaby is waiting for approval.
trakt.connectedDesc: Movies and episodes played in Wicaby are scrobbled to Trakt (start, pause, and stop).

server.plugin: This server’s Trakt plugin already scrobbles, so Wicaby doesn’t do it twice.
server.unknown: Wicaby can’t check plugins without administrator rights. Turn this off if the server already has the Trakt plugin.
server.none: No Trakt plugin on this server: Wicaby scrobbles its plays.

trakt.foot: The Client Secret and tokens are encrypted by Windows on this device and are never logged.
trakt.footLinux: The Client Secret and tokens are encrypted by the system keyring on this device and are never logged.
trakt.title: Trakt

reminderLead.label: Remind Me Before Start
reminderLead.desc: How early to alert you before a program you set a reminder for.

reminderAutoTune.label: Switch Channel at the Reminder
reminderAutoTune.desc: While watching a live channel, switches to the reminder’s channel after 10 seconds unless you choose to stay.

switch.body: You’ll leave {name}. Your devices stay registered there.

diag.title: Diagnostics
diag.copied: Diagnostics copied, with addresses and keys hidden.
